vb_textbox.text: I noticed that two of the gnomes were coloured red and brown, which reminded me of mushrooms, so I grouped those two together. The other group was more spring/summer colours, green and purple. I grouped those two together. It seemed like this was the right idea as the pairs of red/brown and green/purple would alternate being the high scoring pair - I'd pink only red or brown when it was high scoring and most of the time, when I noticed them scoring low, I'd switch to green/purple and they were the high scoring one. Try pairing colours together like that as I think they're paired to be the higher scoring options.
